changes.title: Pointer after boot
items: The 🎶 wave pointer first appears when home's speakers are up, fading in as the ley line's pulse sets off

changes.title: Hud clock
items: A game clock at the top of the screen counts the time played
The wave pointer now follows the ley line's pulse toward the next wave, with 🎶 in its countdown ring
The pointer toward the dancefloor and the wave timer bar on the right are gone

changes.title: Legend circle baby
items: Each sleeping legend's circle now has a wild baby of its own kind in it, which stays inside the circle; only on your leash does it follow you
When an area's soundsystem comes, its wild babies turn happy and join the dancing; if the soundsystem falls, they run off home for good (babies on your leash stay yours)
After a siege the angry animals move on to the next soundsystem, so a legend left with none of its kind wakes angry
The circle's edge is framed by thicker, taller undergrowth, with short sparse tufts on its floor, and its edge is ragged rather than a clean cut
